summary: Hyperliquid Strategies Inc filed a Form 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting Amendment No. 3 to its ChEF Purchase Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC, originally dated October 22, 2025. The amendment resets the pricing formula after the first 160,000,000 shares are sold: VWAP and Intraday VWAP purchases now price at 98.5% of VWAP, and Off-Hour VWAP purchases at 97.0%. No new shares, stake, or deal value were disclosed. This is a routine equity-purchase facility modification, not a special situation; watch only for dilution pace under the facility.
